intake_git_status: clean before this package's first edit
known_predecessor_evidence_boundary: The predecessor disposition, protocol, wind custody, and handoff were required inputs and were read before this freeze. Their published qualitative conclusions and retained hashes are known. No new wind-value series, carrier residual, energy-balance result, or fitted comparison may alter this freeze.
selected_write_set: science-contract index if lifecycle metadata changes
existing contract-derived tests selected after instruction discovery
conditional DRAFT assurance records selected by assurance impact analysis
protected_boundaries: CoE ownership, persistence, promotion, and cutover

accepted_primary_authority.gridmet_gee_asset_metadata: https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/IDAHO_EPSCOR_GRIDMET; asset ID IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET; accessed 2026-08-07; authority only for that distribution asset's daily cadence, 4638.3 m pixel size, status property, units, and nominal 10 m `vs` description
accepted_primary_authority.gridmet_native_product: Abatzoglou 2013, Development of gridded surface meteorological data for ecological applications and modelling, International Journal of Climatology 33:121-131, DOI 10.1002/joc.3413; producer/paper authority for native method claims, not retained request identity
accepted_primary_authority.nldas2: https://ldas.gsfc.nasa.gov/nldas/v2/forcing; NASA GSFC NLDAS-2 forcing documentation; accessed 2026-08-07; corroborating upstream product semantics only, not retained GRIDMET cell, wind exposure, or site applicability
accepted_primary_authority.runtime: local source and retained exact execution/fixture manifests
accepted_primary_authority.site_exposure: only site- or product-specific primary metadata that explicitly establishes wind support and exposure class

required_custody_fields: variable, units, and native-versus-derived wind magnitude rule
grid cell/pixel index or unambiguous sampling geometry

height_symbols.z_gridmet_u_m: nominal GRIDMET wind reference height above the GRIDMET land/model surface; expected 10 m only when actual GRIDMET identity is established; it is not height above instantaneous snow
height_symbols.u_gridmet_m_s: daily gridded wind speed before CLI serialization
height_symbols.u_cli_m_s: daily CLI w-vl value consumed as raw runtime vwind_m_s
height_symbols.u_pmet_2m_m_s: PMET-local FAO-56 10 m-to-2 m adjusted wind; not a Stage 3 input
height_symbols.u_height_adjusted_diagnostic_m_s: a separately labeled authority-only height diagnostic, never raw CLI forcing, production correction, or exposure evidence
height_symbols.z_snow_surface_above_ground_m: instantaneous snow-surface height relative to ground; required if translating a ground-referenced forcing height to snow-surface-relative height
height_symbols.d_m: displacement height used by an admitted diagnostic geometry; its value/formula must have independent provenance and cannot be inferred from desired results

decision_rules.APPLICABLE: complete source custody; authoritative classification of forcing support/exposure; authoritative classification of modeled target snow-surface/canopy class and spatial/temporal claim; and authoritative linkage establishing representativeness
decision_rules.INAPPLICABLE: the same two-sided classifications plus authoritative linkage establishing a conflict for the stated spatial/temporal claim
decision_rules.AUTHORITY_MISSING: any material product/cell/transformation/reference-height/exposure fact is absent or authority does not adjudicate representativeness
decision_rules.no_fitting: wind values, carrier residuals, energy balance, and desired Stage 3 behavior cannot establish exposure or choose attenuation
decision_rules.height_claim_limit: a valid reference-height conversion cannot establish sub-canopy exposure applicability and cannot license a canopy operator
